narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I add the counts and divide by the eight sizes, so the mean is four point five.
<bookmark mark='why'/>Thirty six counts students, not family members. And it treats three students and eleven students as equal.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A size shared by many students must count for more. The bubble is wrong.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows the counts added to 36 and divided by 8 sizes giving 4.5; the bubble is struck in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Multiply each size by its count, add the amounts, and divide by the number of students.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Family sizes two, three, four and five occur one, three, four and two times. Find the mean.
